summary: Comprehensive testing of BookMyLoad Transportation Management System completed. Backend APIs fully functional with authentication. Frontend loads correctly with all navigation working. Minor UI interaction issue with AI Insights input field selector.

minor_issues.issue: Test script expects 'insight' field but response format is correct
minor_issues.impact: Test script issue, not functional issue

ui_bugs.issue: Input field not selectable via standard Playwright selectors
ui_bugs.note: UI elements are visible and functional, selector issue only

passed_tests: Landing page loads with large BookMyLoad logo (224px)
Dashboard loads with stats (5 vehicles, 4 drivers, 2 active trips)
Fleet management page shows vehicle cards
Driver management page shows driver profiles
Trip management page shows trip list with assignment
Live tracking page displays fleet map and vehicle list
Reports page shows comprehensive analytics charts
Backend CRUD operations for vehicles, drivers, trips work
Dashboard stats API returns correct data
AI insights backend endpoint works (confirmed via curl)
